content: Paaziga Ba7aale Bonchcho Woga
Isra7eele asay Gibxeppe kezida nam7anththo layththan koyro aginan GODAY Muses Siina bazzon hizgi yootides,
«Isra7eele asay Paaziga ba7aaleza izi bonchchettiza woden bonchcho;
hayssa ha aginazan tammanne oydanththo gallassa omars wogaa malanne diza maaraa mala bonchcho.»
Hessa gishshas Musey Paaziga ba7aaleza asay bonchchana mala yootides.
Isttika koyro aginay gelida tammanne oydanththo gallas gadey qammishin Siina bazzon Paaziga ba7aaleza bonchchida; Isra7eele asay GODAY Muse azazida mala ubbaa ooththida.

Gido attiin istta garsafe hayqqida aha bochchida gishshas tunida asati istta giddon diza gishshas he gallas Paaziga ba7aaleza bonchchanaas dandaybeettenna; hessa gishshas istti Musekkonne Aaroonekko shiiqidi,
Muses, «Nuni aha bochchidi tunidos shin hankko Isra7eele asaappe dummason nuni iza woden GODAAS yarsho shiishshontta mala aazas digettizonii?» gida.
Museykka isttas, «Tani GODAAPPE izi intte gishshas azazizayssa siyana gakkanaas naagiishshite» gides.
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, ‹Inttefe gidiin woykko intte zereththafe asay aha bochchidi tunikko woykko oge bidaa gidikko izaadey GODAA Paaziga ba7aale bonchchanaas dandayees.
Hessika nam7anththo aginay gelida tammanne oydanththo gallas gadey qammishin bonchchanaas dandayees; istti bonchchishe Paaziga dorsaa irshoy gelontta uketh camo miththa hayththara meto.
Gadey wonttana gakkanaas he kaththaafe aykkoka ashshofetto; shukettida meheza meqeththafe issineyokka menththofetto; isttas imettida wogaa mala ba7aaleza bonchchetto.

Geesh gididinne oge bontta asi oonikka Paaziga ba7aaleza bonchchiza gallas bochchonttaadey ta deraappe shaaketto; izi yarshoza bessiza woden yarshontta aggida gishshas ba nagaraas bessiza qixaate ekko.

« ‹Intte giddon beti yida hara dere asi GODAA Paaziga ba7aaleza bonchchana koykko diza wogaa mala ubbaa poli bonchchanaas bessees; deren yelettidayssa gidiin asa biitta as gidiin hayssa wogaza issi mala polo› gaada yoota.»
Tama Misatiza Shaara
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanezi tokettida gallas shaarazi Dunkaaneza goozi oykkides; omarsafe biidi gadey wonttana gakkanaas Dunkaaneza bolla tama misatiza shaaray kammi oykkides.
Gallas gallas shaaray kammi oykkees; he shaarazikka omars omars tama mala poo7ees.
Shaarazi Dunkaaneza bollafe dendiza wode ubbaan Isra7eele asay ba dunkaani dizasoppe dendi bees; shaarazi eqqiza wode asaykka ba dizason dunkaani uttees.

Isra7eele asay ba dizasoppe dendi biza wode gidiin istti harason dunkaani uttiza wode GODAY istta azazida mala haneettes; shaarazi Dunkaaneza bolla wodhdhidi kammi oykkida wode ubbaan istti bantti dunkaani uttidasohon gam7eettes.
Shaarazi Dunkaaneza bolla daro gallas gam7ikokka istti GODAAS azazeteththan heen ba dunkaani dizason gam7eettes attiin awakka qaaxxettenna.
Issi issi wode shaarazi Dunkaaneza bolla guuththa gallassata xalla gam7ees; gidikkoka heen gadaan istti gam7iko woykko gede sinththe biikko GODAY istta azazida mala haneettes.

Shaarazi issi issi wode gadey wonttana gakkanaas xalla gam7ees; gadey wontishin shaarazi dendida mala heerakka hemeth doommeettes; woykko shaarazi gallas gidiin omars dendiza wode isttika dendi beettes.

Nam7u gallas gidiin woykko issi agina gidiin woykko issi layththika gidiin hessafekka adussa wode shaarazi Dunkaaneza bolla kammi uttida wode ubbaan isttika bantti dunkaani dizasoppe qaaxxettenna; gido attiin shaarazi dendi biza wode isttika dendi hemeth doommeettes.
Istti dunkaani uttizay woykko ba dizasoppe dendi bizay GODAY Muses immida azazoza mala.
